entities.summary: Uzi Fogelman is a former justice of the Supreme Court of Israel and served as the acting president of the Supreme Court of Israel from 16 October 2023 to 1 October 2024, as well as Deputy President from 9 May 2022 to 1 October 2024. Vogelman had a deep impact on Israeli jurisprudence, and especially during his time on the Supreme Court as a liberal justice, issuing several rulings that advanced the rights of minority groups in Israel.
